messages:
sam_sales: Finova follow-up: they want a 2-week POC to migrate off VendorX. Main asks: API compatibility, pricing parity, and security sign-off. Can we scope? :clipboard:

anya_se: We can do a compatibility facade that accepts their /v1/generate shape. Need to know how strict their JSON schema usage is. If they pass schema we should validate and respond with identical shape.

ricardo_re: For prompt parity, we should run their prompts against both stacks and capture deltas. Recommend 100 representative prompts (mix of short/long).

sam_sales: They will share 100 prompts and 10 "blocking" examples they expect exact behavior on. ETA Wed.

sophie_ops: Operational needs: SAML SSO, audit logs to their Splunk, and per-request headers preserved. Can infra expose a staging Private env? @infra-bot

infra-bot: Provision request queued. To proceed we need Finova CIDR and SAML metadata file. Staging env will have webhook sink + syslog forwarder. ETA ~72h after creds.

anya_se: Technical plan sketch:
```
1) facade POST /vendorx/generate -> translate body to our chat API
2) map model names: vendorx-13b -> rdx-13b-compat
3) pass through max_tokens, stop, top_p, temperature
4) capture raw model output, then run schema-enforcer if request.schema present
5) return matching JSON shape and http codes
```

ricardo_re: Addendum: we'll include a post-processing step to normalize whitespace and date formats. That alone fixes ~30% of parity diffs in prior migrations.

sam_sales: Pricing Q: VendorX charges flat per-1k tokens plus premium for schema validation. Will switching to Redwood change unit cost?

anya_se: Hosted pricing unchanged (per-token). For parity with VendorX, we can recommend running a quantized instance (rdx-13b-q4) under Dedicated to match cost. That may affect hallucination/redaction edge cases.

pmce: Legal flagged: contract clause needed for output divergence. They want "no material change in extraction fidelity for core flows" documented in SOW. @legal can draft?

legal: We can add a migration acceptance criteria appendix. Need engineering to define measurable metrics (exact-match %, false-negative rate for redaction).

ricardo_re: Proposed metrics: 1) exact-schema match rate >= 98% for mandatory fields 2) summarization ROUGE-L > 0.7 vs vendor baseline 3) redaction FNR < 1% on blocking set.

sam_sales: Finova also asked about rollback: how quickly can we route back to VendorX if issues?

anya_se: We can proxy with weighted routing in the facade. If error rate > threshold or regression detected, switch 100% back. Can do canary phases.

sophie_ops: Security questionnaire came through (Finova-SecQ-2026.pdf). Key asks: KMS separation, SOC2, incident response timelines. I can draft answers but need KMS options confirmed.

infra-bot: We support customer-managed KMS in Private deployments. Hosted option uses envelope encryption with KMS.

legal: Also need data residency clause if they require EU-only storage. Add to SOW if requested.

ricardo_re: Dev tasks: build facade + test harness to run vendorx vs rdx comparisons, metrics collector, and schema enforcer. Estimate 3 dev days for baseline + 1 day to iterate on failures.

sam_sales: Action items: 1) Finova -> share 100 prompts + 10 blockers (Finova) 2) Infra -> staging + logs (infra-bot) 3) Eng -> scaffold facade + tests (anya/ricardo) 4) Legal -> SOW appendix draft (legal) 5) Ops -> answer sec questionnaire draft (sophie_ops).

anya_se: One more note: if they insist on token-for-token parity, that's basically impossible across different model families. Need to confirm "semantic parity" vs exact text.

sam_sales: I'll confirm with Finova in kickoff. If they need exact text for regulatory reasons, we escalate.

sophie_ops: Also callout: schema-enforcer will return 400 if required keys missing. That matches VendorX behavior, but we should include an opt-out in case they prefer best-effort responses.

pmce: Scheduling kickoff for Thursday 10am PT. I'll send invite and include SOW template.

sam_sales: Great. Will update thread after kickoff. Thanks team :rocket:
